edits.find: 功劳算谁的、由谁来定，得有人先拿出个说法。
edits.replace: 信里称二人“可公平地声称是这一重要的研究方向上的原创思想者”。
edits.reason: 删除作者框架句，改为转述 V-E2 的原话“may both fairly claim the merit of being original thinkers in this important line of inquiry”，使 record 段只保留材料记载。

edits.find: The difficulty was plain to state and awkward to resolve:
edits.reason: 删去“plain to state and awkward to resolve”这类作者框架性评价，与中文“麻烦在于：”对齐。

edits.find: Whose achievement was it, and who had the standing to say so? Someone had to put a version of events on paper first.
edits.replace: Both men, the letter says, "may both fairly claim the merit of being original thinkers in this important line of inquiry."
edits.reason: 以 V-E2 的逐字引语替换作者自设的设问与框架句，英文引语与证据原文逐字一致。
收窄为 V-E12 的“never intended for publication”；1844 年誊本曾被胡克阅读（V-E3），“没打算给人看”不成立。

edits.find: it had never been meant for other eyes
edits.replace: it was never intended for publication
edits.reason: 与中文同步，改为与 V-E12 一致的“never intended for publication”。

edits.find: 而且论文是他自己寄出的
edits.replace: 而且论文由华莱士本人寄给达尔文，并请达尔文若认为它足够新颖、有意思，就转给莱尔
edits.reason: 按 V-E5“sent to him with the expressed wish that it should be forwarded to Sir Charles Lyell, if Mr. Darwin thought it sufficiently novel and interesting”写清寄送路径，避免被读成华莱士自己寄到学会（V-E19 为经莱尔转交）。

edits.find: and it was Wallace himself who had sent it.
edits.replace: and it was Wallace himself who had sent the essay to Darwin, with the express wish that Darwin forward it to Lyell if he thought it sufficiently novel and interesting.
edits.reason: 与中文同步，按 V-E5 写明论文是华莱士寄给达尔文、并请其视新颖与否转交莱尔。

dispositions.reason: 删去“功劳算谁的、由谁来定，得有人先拿出个说法”这一作者框架句及英文对应设问，改为转述 V-E2 原文“may both fairly claim the merit of being original thinkers in this important line of inquiry”，中英同步；该段仍为 record，只保留材料记载。
“它从没打算给人看”改为“它从未打算发表”，与 V-E12“never intended for publication”一致，不再排除 1844 年胡克读过誊本（V-E3）的事实；英文字段同步改为“it was never intended for publication”。
“论文是他自己寄出的”改为按 V-E5 的寄送路径表述：华莱士本人把论文寄给达尔文，并请达尔文若认为足够新颖、有意思就转交莱尔（V-E19 记论文经莱尔转交林奈学会），中英同步。
